Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 112. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

Requires: Wrestling Control and Berserker Super
Saiyan 2
As you draw out more power in your controlled state
your hair spikes up straight and lighting arcs around
you occasionally. You gain the Controlled Super Saiyan
2 Transformation.
This Feat must be obtained through Training Boons
or by completing an Ordeal
